violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoops need to be stored with handle out of product. (Spice bins, ice bins)

Food-contact surfaces - Design and construction. — --Multiuse food-contact surfaces did not meet design and/or construction requirements. -All spice scoops must have handles, do not use cups or bowls.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. -Dispose cracked food storage containers and lids.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean spice scoops. -Clean shelving in walk in cooler.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean all shelving in kitchen and prep areas. -Clean step stool.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Large food containers being washed and rinsed in prep sink. Containers were not being sanitized.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Single use items in storage room were on the floor. Store up off of the floor.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Entire kitchen and prep areas need cleaned.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. -Fly strips are not allowed above food, food prep areas or over clean supplies.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Do not reuse food containers. (Baking powder used to store salt.)

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean shelving in walk in cooler.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean storage shelving in kitchen. -Clean fan covers in walk in cooler. -Clean step stool and table fan.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Clean floors walls and ceiling thoroughly including in walk in cooler.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -Mop was sitting in water.
